notes.title: Patch Note 2.1.0 Demo Update - Lighting Presets and Ducky Room Upgrades
notes.notes:
🗒️ Patch Note 2.1.0 Demo Update



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050414/eb19e38a4a682e1db2385b1b3895eddbaedf419b.png"]

✨ Improvements & New Features:

Added default lighting to each lighting preset - presets now save lighting independently

Added new floor and wall designs in the Ducky Room letting you create complex rooms

Added object SFX and animations while decorating the Ducky Room

Updated Ducky Room BGM for a more chill vibe!

Improved event pacing in the “Missing Meow” level to make it more fun

Improved Ducky Room tutorial text for better clarity

Polished the save system for smoother gameplay

Updated UI visuals and SFX across the entire demo



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050414/6a9639703d5bb9547390f57d4a4d2d906e7fdeb8.gif"]



🐞 Bug Fixes:

Fixed an issue where invisible UI could be clicked during the Quack Quack tutorial

Fixed a bug where UI disappeared during dimension transitions in "The Missing Captain"

Fixed a looping SFX bug in the "Missing Meow" level

Fixed missing SFX for objects and characters in the "Missing Meow" level

Fixed blurry thumbnail image for the "Missing Meow" level

Fixed an issue where BGM overlapped when entering the Ducky Room

Fixed a bug where the Ducky Room was unusable with a gamepad

Fixed missing asset bar during Ducky Room editing

Fixed Juju and currency notification UI not hiding when viewing hints

Fixed Kit not playing animations in the Kit Shop



Join our Discord or Steam Forum to let us know about what you think about this update and report any bugs!

Thank you for your support! 💛



- Ducky

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050414/8779bf7670596dd16d2a08500fb85f148d314ce4.png"]

Lost and Found Co. team

notes.title: We’re LIVE at Wholesome Celebration with a Localization Update!
notes.notes:
Today's the big day!

We’re excited to announce a new localization update just in time for Wholesome Celebration 2024!

[previewyoutube=oM56U-KnoR8;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks to our amazing community, the Lost and Found Co. demo is now available in 12 languages: 

 English
 French
 Brazilian Portuguese
 Spanish
 German
 Italian
 Russian
 Turkish
 Indonesian
 Traditional Chinese
 Simplified Chinese
 Thai
